title: Gentle Design: next features
brief: Eleven proposed canvas features shown inside the Brand rail canvas: screen sizes, version history, token inspector, overlay compare, accessibility checks, agent replies, live thumbnails, minimap, another direction, PNG export and Spanish/English UI.

artboards.title: Screen sizes and live thumbnails
artboards.tradeoff: Ideas 1 and 7: see one artboard at phone, tablet and desktop widths side by side; costs canvas space and needs designs that are responsive

artboards.title: Version history and agent replies
artboards.tradeoff: Ideas 2 and 6: compare and restore any earlier version, and read what the agent did per comment; adds a fourth tab and stored snapshots

artboards.title: Token inspector and accessibility checks
artboards.tradeoff: Ideas 3 and 5: spot colors, fonts and spacing off the system and contrast or target-size problems; one more panel to read

artboards.title: Compare with overlay
artboards.tradeoff: Idea 4: overlay, slider and difference modes catch small mismatches between design and app; differences are only as good as both render at the same size

artboards.title: Minimap, another direction and export
artboards.tradeoff: Ideas 8, 9 and 10: faster navigation, one-click variants and PNG export from an artboard menu; the menu hides actions that were one click away

artboards.title: Spanish or English
artboards.tradeoff: Idea 11: the whole canvas in Spanish or English, starting from the browser's language; every new label must be written twice
